messages:
maya: CI nsys harvest is failing intermittently on the rt-gpu runners — nightly perf diff has missing traces for ~20% of runs. noticed this after the kernel-selector change. anyone seen similar?
jon: saw one failure this morning, stack: harvester uploads a 0-byte .qdump then S3 returns 200 but content-length=0. ci-bot later marks job as passed, so dashboards show stale data.
sam: that 0-byte qdump rings a bell — last week we added the async upload path in the harvester to avoid blocking. maybe race with tar creation?
anya: can you paste the job id / s3 path? I can check raw runner disk.
maya: job: nightly-profiling/1954319001, s3 prefix: s3://redwood-perf/nightly/2026-03-16/nsys/1954319001/
jon: logs snippet from runner:
```
[harvester] creating archive /tmp/nsys-1954319001.tar.gz
[harvester] spawn uploader (async)
[harvester] removed tmp files
[uploader] upload complete: out.qdump (size=0)
[uploader] exit code 0
```
sam: uploader exiting 0 on size=0 suggests process didn't wait for tar close. simplest repro: run harvester with `-n` (no upload) and `--async-upload` toggles.
anya: I pulled /tmp on the runner — the tar exists and has qdump inside, size ~120MB, but the uploader saw 0. Could be streaming pipe got closed before md5/length computed.
perf-bot: perf-diff job triggered: nightly-profiling-diff/1954320000 — failing due to missing baseline artifacts :warning:
jon: hypothesis: kernel-selector loop added a quick exit on specific models which ends NVTX profiling earlier; harvester tries to upload while nsys is still finalizing. NVidia tools flush on process exit, race can yield truncated qdump.
maya: good thinking. I can add a `nsys finalize` wait in the harvester to block until the profiler fully exits. but want minimal change — maybe re-order to ensure file rename is atomic before upload.
sam: or a retry loop: check uploaded object size, if 0 or < MIN_BYTES then re-upload from local path, with backoff. robustness > micro-opts.
anya: infra-bot, are there runner-level IO load spikes during nightly? last night we had a concurrent quantization benchmark flood.
infra-bot: metric dump: rt-pool-3 io_wait spiked 40% between 02:10-02:25 UTC, coincides with ~15 parallel nsight jobs.
maya: ok, plan: 1) add simple post-upload size check and retry (sam) 2) add nsys finalization wait flag (maya) 3) make harvester log more NVTX/kernel timeline markers to correlate with kernel-selector (jon) 4) add a CI smoke test to simulate a slow FS and ensure uploader retries (anya).
jon: for (3) I can add a small wrapper that emits `NVTX_PUSH` before kernel selection and `NVTX_POP` after, so traces show the exact kernel-selection window. that will help see if profiler ends early.
maya: adding example command to reproduce locally:
```
nsys profile -o out --trace=nvtx,cuda --sample=none --app-trace false --target-processes=all --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi ./run_inference.sh && sleep 2
```
try with `sleep 0` and `sleep 2` to see truncation difference.
sam: i'll draft the retry patch: pseudo:
```
upload(path) {
  put();
  size = head_object_size();
  if (size < 1024) retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff
}
```
anya: I'll wire a smoke CI job `ci-smoke/nsys-upload-retry` that runs in the nightly pool with artificial FS slowness (dd writing to tmpfs + ionice). If that passes we can flip to true nightly.
perf-bot: created ticket PERF-4721 "harvester: uploader robustness for truncated qdump" and attached logs.
maya: one more thing — check kernel selection PR for early return conditions that call `exit(0)` without letting child processes clean up. that was a subtle bug in v2.4.
jon: ack, i'll audit the PR and add a test to simulate a canary model that triggers the fast-path.
sam: I'll open the patch MR and include unit test + integration harness. will tag reviewers @jon @maya.
maya: thanks everyone. i'll monitor the diff dashboard after the retry patch lands. :eyes:
ci-bot: nightly job queued: ci-smoke/nsys-upload-retry (pool: rt-nightly).
maya: leaving a note for release: if any perf diffs show large regressions after the kernel-selector audit, prioritize rollback to previous selector until harvester fixes land.
jon: agreed — also let's add a smoke alert if missing artifacts >5% of nightly runs.
anya: i'll set an alert in the dashboard: `artifact_missing_rate > 0.05` for 1h.
maya: closing loop — will post follow-up once MR merges and first successful nightly with retries completes. :thumbsup:
